items.title: Show HN: Guided sentence diagramming to practice grammar
items.desc: title: Grammar meta: description: "Improve your grammar with sentence diagrams, not LLMs." "og:description": "Improve your grammar with sentence diagrams, not LLMs." "og:title": Grammar LessonsSettings [GitHub](https://github.com/adams/grammar) [Adam Sohn](https://adamsohn.com) Lessons Frame 1. 01 Introduction 2. 02 A subject and predicate give a sentence its basic shape 3. 03 Find the main verb 4. 04 Noun phrases 5. 05 Find the head 6. 06 Determiners 7. 07 Pronouns Predict 1. 08 Verbs that stand alone 2. 09 Verbs that take an object 3. 10 Linking verbs 4. 11 The verb be 5. 12 Two objects 6. 13 Naming the object 7. 14 When an adverbial is required 8. 15 The six types, one procedure Phrases 1. 16 Adjectives before nouns 2. 17 Adjective phrases 3. 18 Adverbs and adverb phrases 4. 19 Prepositional phrases 5. 20 Form is not function 6. 21 Modifiers after the head 7. 22 Appositives 8. 23 Numbers in noun phrases 9. 24 Auxiliary verbs 10. 25 Particles 11. 26 Coordination inside phrases 12. 27 Attachment changes meaning Clauses 1. 28 Main and dependent clauses 2. 29 Adverbial clauses 3. 30 Nominal clauses 4. 31 Relative clauses 5. 32 Comparative clauses 6. 33 Coordination between clauses Reduced and marked 1. 34 Infinitive clauses 2. 35 Participial clauses 3. 36 Gerund clauses 4. 37 Passive voice 5. 38 Interjections and edge words 6. 39 Punctuation is evidence 7. 40 Final synthesis 01 · Frame Introduction Improve your grammar with sentence diagrams, not LLMs. What words mean depends partly on how they relate to other words in a sentence. Syntax describes those relationships and the roles words take in them. Seeing the structure more clearly can improve both reading and writing. Thehorseracedpastthebarnfell After at least 12 years of studying grammar and syntax, most of this will be familiar. This review brings back the terms for relationships you already use when you read and write. Max Morenberg's Doing Grammar is the book I have always used to refresh my understanding of syntax. This guide follows much of his approach, with coding agents helping to turn sentence diagrams into interactive tools. reading the diagram Form and function answer different questions Each diagram label tells you what a word or group of words is and what job it does here. Grammar calls those two answers form and function. What kind of unit is it? NP · Noun phrase The words form a noun phrase. SubjNP What job does it do here? Subj · subject That noun phrase is the subject of the sentence. Labels in the first sentence diagram Form · what it is Function · what it does NPNoun phrase Subjsubject VPVerb phrase Predpredicate In the first diagram, the horse raced past the barn has the form NP and the function subject. the problem The sentence is grammatical, but difficult to read The horse raced past the barn fell. Most readers hesitate at fell. Up to that point, raced looks like the main verb. The final word forces a second reading, but the sentence is wellformed English. A fuller version makes the intended grouping easier to see: The horse that was raced past the barn fell. The horse did not race past the barn. Someone raced the horse, and the horse fell. The words raced past the barn identify which horse the sentence is about. the stakes A grammar dispute led to a $5 million settlement In 2017, dairy drivers in Maine sued for unpaid overtime. State law listed work that did not earn overtime, and the drivers delivered food rather than packed it. The case turned in part on how the final words in this list were grouped: packing for shipment or distribution of perishable food Two possible groupings and what each one means Grouping What it means packing for \[shipment or distribution] This names one kind of work: packing. Delivery is not exempt, so the drivers are owed overtime. \[packing for shipment] or \[distribution] This names two kinds of work. Distribution is exempt, so the drivers would receive nothing. The missing comma did not decide the case by itself. The court considered the grammar and the rest of the law, found the wording ambiguous, and applied Maine’s rule that such uncertainty favours the worker. The case later settled for about five million dollars. The individual words were not in dispute. The dispute was over which words belonged together, and that difference changed what work the law covered. Start analyzing Ten sentences from this lesson, one decision at a time. Sentences Introduction Practice sentences 01 Birds sing. 02 The bell rang twice. 03 Those lanterns flickered. 04 The old gate creaked loudly. 05 Birds sang through the evening. 06 The dog by the door barked. 07 My brother sneezed twice. 08 The woman in blue smiled. 09 Two birds scattered suddenly. 10 The kettle boiled over. items.author: dataviz1000
items.descZh: 这是一套基于句法图解（sentence diagrams）的英语语法学习网页课程，由作者 Adam Sohn 开发，区别于当下流行的 LLM 辅助学习方式，强调通过可视化结构来理解句子。课程共分 Frame、Predict、Phrases、Clauses、Reduced and marked 五大模块共 40 课，系统覆盖主谓结构、动词类型、短语功能、从句关系及省略形式等语法核心概念。其最大亮点在于"形式（form）与功能（function）"的区分方法：每个图解标签同时揭示一个词或词组"是什么"与"在这里做什么"，并配有 10 句由浅入深的互动分析练习，例如 "Birds sing."、"The old gate creaked loudly."、"The dog by the door barked." 等。文中用真实案例凸显语法歧义的高昂代价——2017 年缅因州乳制品司机因法律条款 "packing for shipment or distribution of perishable food" 的分组方式不同（"packing for [shipment or distribution]" 对比 "[packing for shipment] or [distribution]"），导致加班工资豁免与否的争议，最终以约 500 万美元和解。课程借助 AI 编码代理将传统纸质图解转化为交互工具，适合希望系统重建语法底层认知、追求精确表达与深度阅读能力的写作者、学生及语言学习者，尤其对法律、技术文档等对句法严谨度有高要求的从业者具有实用价值。
items.quote: 相关词组本身并无争议。争议在于哪些词应当组合在一起，而这种差异会改变法律所适用的对象。
items.titleZh: Show HN：通过引导式句子图解练习语法

[](/interrupt21h/tubeviz/blob/main/media/tubevizsample.webp) tubeviz turns a music track and a library of source footage into a beataligned, AIdirected music video. It can acquire and curate footage, detect scenes, analyze music, plan an edit, apply visual treatments, preview the result interactively, and render a finished video. Tubeviz provides both a browserbased Studio workflow and a full commandline interface. Both operate on the same persistent media library and the same directed timeline format. Note A hack that got out of hand 🛠️ Tubeviz started as a quick experiment to see whether video could be automatically cut to music. Then things escalated. It’s now a full videoanalysis, composition, and rendering system—and it’s still very much a work in progress, so beware of rough edges and sudden changes. Repository files navigation cdai the AIenhanced cd command [](https://github.com/franzenzenhofer/cdai/actions/workflows/ci.yml) Jump to the directory you mean, even if you have never visited it before. Install Requires Node.js 20+. Homebrew reuses an active compatible Node on PATH, including one activated by nvm, fnm, asdf, Volta or mise. Otherwise it uses an alreadyinstalled Homebrew Node or installs one automatically. Homebrew is the recommended onecommand install: brew install franzenzenhofer/tap/cdai See how it works [](/franzenzenhofer/cdai/blob/main/docs/demo.gif) The GIF runs the real completion, picker, AI validation, confirmation and alias paths. Its AI backend is a deterministic local shim from docs/demofixture.sh, so the recording is repeatable and never needs network access or model credentials. Rerecord it with sh docs/demofixture.sh && vhs docs/demo.tape (requires vhs and fzf). Finish setup Enable cdai in your shell: Shell Config file Add this line zsh \~/.zshrc eval "$(cdai init zsh)" Bash \~/.bashrc eval "$(cdai init bash)" Fish \~/.config/fish/config.fish cdai init fish \ source Then start a new shell and finish setup: exec "$SHELL" cdai setup cdai doctor Prefer npm? With Node.js 20+ installed: npm install g github:franzenzenhofer/cdai Coming from zoxide? cdai import zoxide seeds the local frecency database. For explicit, noninteractive setup: cdai setup root "$HOME/dev" depth 3 yes noai cdai keeps normal cd behavior, adds a local directory index and frecency, understands intent such as latest or 2025, and can use an optional AI fallback that is not allowed to invent a path. The fast path and every Tab completion are deterministic and modelfree. The 30second version $ cdai pet<Tab $ cdai petalworks → ~/Dropbox/clients/petalworks $ cdai latest petalworks folder → ~/Dropbox/clients/petalworks/petalworks2026 $ cdai petalworks 2025 → ~/Dropbox/clients/petalworks/petalworks2025 $ cdai that client with the flowers cdai: thinking... (apfel) cdai: ~/Dropbox/clients/petalworks (petalworks = flowersthemed client name) [Y/n] → ~/Dropbox/clients/petalworks the confirmed wording is now a local, modelfree alias $ cdai that client with the flowers → ~/Dropbox/clients/petalworks Property What cdai does Native behavior Tries your shell's real cd first; paths, flags, cd , CDPATH and errors stay native Cold directories Indexes configured roots, so unvisited folders are searchable Smart Tab Completes prefixes, compact forms and bounded typos from local cached state Common intent Handles latest, oldest, years and in <root without AI Vague intent Optionally asks an AI to choose from existing, preapproved paths Runtime footprint One bundl
items.author: franze
items.descZh: 这是一款名为 cdai 的开源命令行工具，作为传统 cd 命令的 AI 增强替代方案，旨在解决用户在大量项目中难以快速定位目录的痛点。它通过构建本地目录索引并结合 frecency（频率+时效）算法，使用户即使从未访问过某个目录也能通过模糊匹配、紧凑形式甚至轻微拼写错误完成跳转，同时支持 latest、2025 等常见意图识别。亮点在于其"模型无关"的快速路径设计：所有 Tab 补全和常规跳转均无需调用 AI，仅当用户输入模糊自然语言（如"那个做花的客户"）时才会触发 AI 兜底，且 AI 被严格限制只能从已存在路径中选取而不能凭空编造路径，兼顾速度与安全；演示 GIF 使用确定性脚本保证可重复录制，无需联网或模型凭证。安装方式多样，推荐通过 Homebrew 一行命令完成，并兼容 nvm、fnm、asdf、Volta、mise 等 Node 版本管理工具，需要 Node.js 20+ 环境。它特别适合需要在多项目、多客户端目录间频繁切换的开发者，同时为从 zoxide 迁移的用户提供种子数据导入命令。
items.quote: cdai 保留了普通 cd 的行为，增加了本地目录索引和 frecency 排序，能够理解例如 latest 或 2025 这样的意图，并可使用可选的 AI 回退功能，该功能

items.descZh: 作者尝试在 macOS 的 Claude Code CLI 状态栏中加入基于其工作状态的趣味动画，仅使用 emoji 实现了鱼缸和 safari 场景。受 80 年代童年影响，他进一步挑战 Fable 5 生成 Ms Pac-Man 主题动画与精细像素角色（sprites）。该项目展示了利用极简 emoji 与 LLM 协作快速产出复古风交互视觉效果的可能性。典型应用包括为开发者命令行工具增添个性化、情感化反馈，提升长时间编码的体验。
